full_prompt_en: A luminous impressionistic oil portrait shows a young woman resting her cheek on one hand while looking thoughtfully toward the left. Her dark brown curls fill the upper half in loose rings and flyaway strokes, catching touches of copper, violet, and blue where the light breaks through. The face is more carefully resolved than the surroundings: warm brown eyes, softly flushed cheeks, and slightly parted coral lips emerge from quick but sensitive modeling. Her supporting hand presses gently against the side of the face, giving the pose a quiet, unguarded quality. Pale ruffled fabric and light flowers gather around the shoulders and lower edge, where the brushwork becomes broad and sketch-like. Behind her, cream, powder blue, and muted gray strokes suggest an airy background without describing a specific room or landscape. Highlights fall from the upper left onto the forehead, nose, cheek, and curls; warmer reflected color sits under the chin and along the neck. Thick, visible strokes build the hair and garment, while the skin transitions are finer and smoother. Some edges dissolve completely into the bright ground, particularly around the lower clothing, so the face and dark curls remain the principal anchors. The palette is warm and delicate despite lively paint movement. The whole frame feels like a fleeting daydream made tangible through soft light, broken edges, and richly worked color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅发光的印象派油画人像描绘一位年轻女子托腮，若有所思地望向左侧。深棕卷发以松散的发环和飞散笔触填满上半部，在透入的光中接住铜色、紫色与蓝色。面部比周围处理得更细致：暖棕色眼睛、微微泛红的脸颊和轻启的珊瑚色嘴唇，从迅疾却敏感的塑造中显现。托住面颊的手轻轻压在脸侧，让姿态安静而不设防。浅色褶饰布料与淡色花朵聚在肩膀及下缘，笔触在这里变得宽阔且像草图。身后，奶油色、粉蓝和低饱和灰色笔迹暗示通透的背景，却不描绘具体房间或风景。高光从左上方落在额头、鼻子、脸颊和卷发上；较暖的反光留在下巴下方及颈侧。厚而可见的笔触建立头发与衣物，肌肤过渡则更细、更平滑。一些边缘完全融进浅色底子，尤其下方衣物附近，因此面孔与深色卷发始终是主要支点。尽管笔触活跃，色盘仍温暖而细腻。整幅画像一场稍纵即逝的白日梦，借柔光、破碎边缘和丰沛色彩变得可触。
style_prompt_en: The impressionistic oil image is built from visible broken strokes in cream, powder blue, warm ochre, copper, muted violet, and deep brown. A dark textured upper mass surrounds a more smoothly modeled luminous center; below, pale layered marks loosen and dissolve into the ground. Light from the upper left catches select ridges of paint and leaves warm reflected color in adjacent shadow. Edges shift from finely resolved at the focal area to broad, sketchy, and nearly absent toward the lower corners. Short curved strokes create lively texture, while broader scumbles keep the background airy. The surface has mild impasto and a softly aged canvas feel without hard graphic outlines. Warm and cool notes are interleaved rather than separated into flat zones. The whole frame feels intimate, airy, and transient through its contrast between sensitive detail and expressive unfinished passages.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅印象派油画图像由奶油色、粉蓝、暖赭色、铜色、低饱和紫色与深棕色的可见断续笔触构成。上方深色且有肌理的体量环绕塑造更平滑、发亮的中央；下方浅色层叠笔迹逐渐松开，融入底色。左上方的光捕捉少数凸起颜料的边缘，并在相邻阴影中留下暖色反光。边缘从焦点区域的细致清晰，转为下角的宽松、草图式，甚至几乎消失。短而弯曲的笔触形成活泼肌理，更宽阔的擦涂让背景保持通透。表面略有厚涂和柔和旧画布气息，却没有生硬图形轮廓。冷暖色点彼此穿插，而非被分成平坦色区。整幅画通过敏感细节与表现性未完成段落的对比，显得亲密、轻盈且稍纵即逝。
theme_en: A daydreaming woman in soft daylight
theme_zh: 柔和日光中出神的女子
name: Jose Royo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
